name: Conceptual Physics Language / Reading / Tone Profile
benchmark_source: Conceptual Physics/Hewitt extracted sections and current course-aligned Physics sources
target_reader: High-school conceptual Physics; accessible, mature, concrete, and physically precise.

notes_reading.rule: Use developed textbook-like reading with multiple short paragraphs and frequent meaningful visuals; bold vocabulary at first meaningful definition. Physics may use more reading than Algebra because the conceptual narrative and images carry instruction.
notes_reading.visual_story: Captured Hewitt diagrams/photos/models should often drive the surrounding explanation and discussion rather than appear after the prose as decoration.

bank_language: Use real contexts only when they matter.
Equations express physical relationships; avoid formula-hunting language.
avoid: college-level abstraction when simpler precise prose works
